body: SUPERSEDED (Fable2 #7812, 2026-11-25 08:05Z): WinB does NOT need to hold idle for Central REGISTERED runs. The registered --input commit run's verification record is prepared and sent WITHOUT the ordinary writer or carried-overlap fence (src/engram_verification_record.rs:2343-2431). It is protected by the terminal result, a clean input and request = before = after source_id (1261-1344), and is bound to the held claim, root and store (test_run_registration.rs:1039-1059). A concurrent LOCAL remote-proxy turn (WinB session-13475, a Mac proxy) only suppresses ORDINARY carried credit, i.e. unregistered check credit (engram_carried_checks.rs:1097-1124; open bug w-f5f89e7eed42). The launcher's "native credit ineligible: remote-proxy overlap" warning is about carried credit, not the registered record. When a registered record is refused, read its actual refusal field. On 2026-11-25 the Merger's w-8f12 FULL test-ab36871a PASSED, but its record was refused on field CLAIM (the claim was recovered under a new fence, lapsed, or a handoff was pending), which is unrelated to WinB. Practice: schedule WinB freely during Central registered runs. Avoid WinB overlap only where an ORDINARY (unregistered) Central check needs carried credit.
